environment: macOS arm64, Python 3.14.7, Node 26.10.0, Playwright CLI 0.1.22 (Chromium), axe-core 4, production Next.js build, throwaway SQLite, Ollama qwen2.5:7b + bge-m3:567m
scope: SYNTHETIC ENGINEERING VERIFICATION. Fictional data only. Not participant usability evidence and not WCAG certification.
checks: Every course task is listed as a focusable star button
Keyboard changes the time budget, re-plans and autosaves
Stale tab write is refused and asks for a reload
Course-change banner links to the digest
Tab moves between star buttons with a visible focus ring
List view shows every task with a completion checkbox
Digest lists all 7 computed changes as the source of truth
Digest shows a plain-English summary (live model)
Marking the digest as seen updates progress
Empty coach question shows an inline error
Coach answer carries at least one source citation
Coach abstains on an off-topic question
Approved message is queued locally and never sent
Coordinator role-play can answer a queued question
Fictional examples load with a visible banner
Privacy guard rejects a note with a phone number
A code quote that is not in the note is rejected
Local AI suggests codes that a person accepts
A theme is created from the empathy map
A question that does not start with How might we is rejected
One vote per person per idea
Alternative scores are saved and averaged
Freezing the protocol records a SHA-256 fingerprint
Ethics panel shows logged AI calls
Story mode moves by keyboard and buttons and stays honest about evidence
Import preview still validates the sample CSV
Review queue still saves a review
System theme follows the operating system
Sidebar link navigates and marks the current page
No hydration or root-unmount console errors
